name: ERTH 3230
title: Beaches and Coasts
description: (Also offered as MARN 3230.) Introduction to the processes that form and modify coasts and beaches, including tectonic setting, sediment supply, coastal composition, energy regimes and sea level change; tools and techniques utilized in marine geologic mapping and reconstruction of submerged coastal features; field trips to selected coastal features.
requirement_description: MARN 1002 or MARN 1003 or ERTH 1050 or ERTH 1051, or consent of instructor.
